events.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Android console
events.titleJa: Android コンソールの Teams Rooms からのアドホックな部屋予約
events.titleEn: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Android console
events.summary: With Teams Rooms on Android consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
events.summaryJa: Android コンソールの Teams Rooms を使用すると、すぐに使用できる会議室をすぐに予約できるため、スケジュールの競合を回避し、中断のない自発的な会議を確保できます。 Teams Rooms Pro ライセンスが付与されたルームで利用できます。
events.summaryEn: With Teams Rooms on Android consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
events.importanceReason: 提供開始済みで利用可否の確認に直結するため / ライセンス設計や展開判断に直結するため

events.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
events.titleJa: Copilot の拡張トピック割り当て
events.titleEn: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
events.summary: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics.
events.summaryJa: Copilot を利用できるようにトピック割り当てパイプラインをアップグレードし、アンケートのコメントを関連トピックに分類する精度が大幅に向上しました。
events.summaryEn: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics.
events.importanceReason: 提供開始済みで利用可否の確認に直結するため / 管理やガバナンスへの影響が大きいため

events.title: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual recap available with translation button
events.titleJa: 翻訳ボタンで多言語の要約が利用可能
events.titleEn: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual recap available with translation button
events.summary: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.
events.summaryJa: 会議中に選択した翻訳言語で会議の要約が自動的に生成されると、ユーザーは生成後に会議の要約の言語を引き続き変更できます。
events.summaryEn: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

events.titleJa: Copilot が文書構造を活用した長文ファイル ナビゲーションを強化
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot improved long files navigation using document structure, enabling more accurate answers and clearer citations.
events.summary: We’ve improved how Copilot reads long and complex files by making it more aware of document structure.
